name: tracker-session-health
goal: Prove ten-minute native Tracker health detection, verified prompt submission, conservative recovery and CoS visibility on both Macs.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Native tick runs idle/startup only and legacy recovery services are disconnected. Native tmux reports key delivery without verifying Codex submission. Prior Tracker incidents are ztgxwd, 1r5v1k, mymm0t, and wkk03d.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Extend the existing native runtime watchdog test to exercise the operation from its dry-run API and verify durable CoS visibility, plus the existing tmux pane-identity workload to verify key submission.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Exact test on b33f384f7c; Codex composer still contained the draft after one Enter.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Use native Tracker dispatch and ownership checks. Confirm Codex submission against the original pane, and recheck live inventory before recovery.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Native watchdog health scan, context handoff, startup and queue alerts, verified input, and CoS routing.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Exact frozen test failed at a33cfd4f2b6d94f9e07b9a0dc9ff71a3608640a3 and passed at 5b916e8c558fbbfaf00caad0c1e3c59d84ed82e4.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: An isolated worktree with the original tmux adapter and the full frozen test corpus rejected the one-Enter implementation. The implementation-only follow-up passed the unchanged guard.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
